# schema-codegen

> Generate Pydantic v2 models and TypeScript types from one JSON Schema model graph, injection-safe, with a CI check mode for stale outputs Python package `trysac-schema-codegen`, import name `schema_codegen`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
